item.title: ext.pgsty.com
item.description:
ext.pgsty.com is the PostgreSQL Extension Catalog: search across extensions, package families, dependencies, and the exact PostgreSQL and operating-system combinations each one is available for. The catalogue indexes 2,241 extensions, 576 of them packaged, across 16 Linux platforms and 5 major PostgreSQL versions.

What it demonstrates

  • A queryable dataset presented as the primary object of a site, with the reading shell kept out of its way.
  • A catalogue and its prose living in one OINK site, the same arrangement PG Exporter and pigsty.io use for their own structured data.
